title: C482/161/2013 of MANGEY RAM AND ANOTHER Vs STATE AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Misc. Application No. 161 of 2013
(Under Section 482 Cr.P.C.)
Mangey Ram & another .......... Applicants
versus
State and others .......... Respondents
Mrs. Neetu Singh, Advocate for the applicants.
Mr. Prem Kaushal, Brief Holder for the State.
None is present on behalf of the respondent no.3.
U. C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)
 By means of present application under Section 482
Cr.P.C., applicants seek to quash the entire criminal proceedings under
Sections 504 & 506 of IPC passed by the Additional Chief Judicial
Magistrate, Roorkee in Criminal Case No.3733 of 2011 (State vs.
Mangey Ram & another), pending in the Court of Additional Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee.
2. It is the submission of the learned counsel for the applicant
that on a bare perusal of the allegations, ingredients of such offences
are not made out and further continuance of criminal proceedings in
respect of a property dispute against the applicants shall be an abuse of
the process of the Court.

3. Notice was issued to respondent no.3. Registry has
indicated that respondent no.3 has died. His legal representatives have
not come forward to pursue the prosecution.
4. At the time of admission of present C-482 petition, this
Court passed an interim order, vide order dated 22.02.2013, and stayed
the proceedings of the case initiated against the applicants under
Sections 504 & 506 of IPC, pending in the Court of Additional Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, till the next date of listing.

-2-
5. It will be a futile exercise to keep present petition under
Section C-482 Cr.P.C. pending in this Court.
6. The petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, therefore,
allowed. The summoning order under Sections 504 & 506 of IPC,
passed by the Additional Chief Magistrate, Roorkee, in Criminal Case
No.3733 of 2011 (State vs. Mangey Ram & another), pending in the
Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, are hereby
quashed, qua applicants only.
7. Since present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is
being decided in the absence of respondent no.3, liberty is granted to
the legal representatives of the deceased (complainant-respondent no.3)
to move for recall of this order, if they feel aggrieved with the same.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
 03.07.2017
A.kaur
